details.description: Genteel Matic detergent liquid for the washing machine is an all-purpose laundry detergent from the house of Godrej. It is the best solution for your everyday clothes. The special strong formula of Genteel washing machine liquid delivers thorough cleansing for whites as well as your coloured clothes. Genteel has an added fabric conditioner that softens the fabric and leaves your clothes with a lingering fragrance. This liquid detergent for top-load washing machines has a functionally superior design that is easy to handle. The pH-neutral no-soda formula prevents your clothes from shrinking and fading. This top-load washing machine liquid is ideal for all those clothes that need a little extra care because it's safe and gentle on your expensive lingerie, shawls, silks, woollens, and even babywear.
